references.text: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons, as most holy among the Lord's fire offerings.
Aaron and his sons shall eat what remains of the grain offering; it is unleavened bread and must be eaten in a holy place.
Describes how the grain offering belongs to the priest who presents it.
Moses instructs Aaron and his surviving sons to eat the grain offering without yeast at the altar, in a holy place.
The showbread belongs to Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat them in a holy place.
Aaron and his sons shall eat the breast meat and the bread at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
What is most holy that is not burned belongs to the priests and must be eaten in a holy place.
Ezekiel's temple vision describes that the priests shall eat the most holy offerings in holy rooms.
